description:
Conduct fundamental research on memory systems, cognition, and AI. Define the scientific foundation for next-generation memory augmentation technologies.

 

What You'll Do

 - Conduct original research on memory augmentation and contextual AI

 - Design and execute experiments to test research hypotheses

 - Publish findings in top-tier conferences and journals

 - Collaborate with engineers to transition research into products

 - Stay current with latest developments in AI, NLP, and cognitive science

 - Mentor research engineers and contribute to team growth

 - Present research findings to internal teams and external audiences

What We're Looking For

 - PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Cognitive Science, or related field

 - 2+ years of research experience (academic or industry)

 - Track record of publications in top conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ACL, etc.)

 - Deep expertise in machine learning, NLP, or information retrieval

 - Strong mathematical and statistical foundation

 - Proficiency in Python and ML frameworks

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills

 - Ability to work on open-ended research problems

Nice to Have

 - Experience with memory systems or knowledge representation

 - Background in cognitive psychology or neuroscience

 - Industry research experience at top labs

 - Experience with large language models and retrieval systems

 - Postdoctoral research experience

 - Track record of research-to-product transitions

 - Experience leading research teams or projects
